text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the Aoi Stakes, Calstone 
Light O kept honing her speed, aiming to 
break her top speed record.
choice_data_list:
Your legs are slowing down! Focus on 
picking up the pace!

Your legs are slowing down! Focus on 
picking up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah...
choice_data_list:
Try to relax a little more when you pick 
up your pitch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you tense up more than necessary, it 
will actually act as a brake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue builds up especially in the final 
stretch, and that eager drive to push 
forward makes it easy to tense up and 
overextend your stride.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, except for the initial 
acceleration—from the middle surge 
onwards, the higher your pitch rate, the 
faster you go. And lighter strides make it 
easier to increase that pitch.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even when I try to pick up my cadence, I 
just end up tensing up too much...
choice_data_list:
Then, I thought if I just moved my legs 
faster, I'd go faster.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to worry about pacing or 
stride frequency. I told her to just 
remember that if her legs churn faster, 
she'll run faster."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Move my legs faster. I'll give it a 
try.
choice_data_list:
After the break, let's time you over 
1200m.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: (Faster— Just move my legs faster!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff*... Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you set a new personal record!
Yeah, that's a new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I knew it! Wait, this much?!
choice_data_list:
It's because you were able to run without 
tensing up.

It's because you were able to run without 
tensing up.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that might be true. I feel like I was 
able to run with ease.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An easy run—in other words, running 
relaxed. By not overthinking it, she 
naturally ran in the way most comfortable 
for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running in pursuit of top speed is what's 
truly best for her.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you telling me not to 
overcomplicate things.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That run felt so refreshing!
choice_data_list:
Maybe that's why. Your form looked 
beautiful too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
! Beautiful. It was beautiful?! I finally 
got a passing mark from you!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No wonder she shattered the record by such 
a wide margin!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! That was incredible, Trainer! 
Really, truly amazing! I want to give you 
a Super-Duper Award!
choice_data_list:
What's truly amazing is all your hard 
work.

What's truly amazing is all your hard 
work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Basic training, correcting form. Even if 
the results were minuscule, she continued 
to work hard with earnest dedication.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All those accumulated efforts are now 
beginning to bear fruit.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even so. I couldn't have done it on my 
own.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad I teamed up with you. Really. 
Truly. Absolutely! I'm so glad!!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I can say this with total 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
At the Aoi Stakes, I can unleash my 
fastest speed ever!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do one more run before I forget 
how that felt!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Guh! In that case, I'll do image training!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait, pronghorn! Today, victory 
will be mine!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I will reach the highest speed in my 
history!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the Aoi Stakes, Calstone Light O 
announced this with absolute confidence.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The only thing that comes to mind is the 
image of myself running ideally! This is 
undoubtedly an omen!
choice_data_list: Then go out there and make it a reality!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Look, doesn't Calstone Light O look like 
she's in top form today?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"True. She's relaxed and the atmosphere is 
great. But her expression is the same as 
always... Am I just imagining things?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
This race will set the tone for the 
Classic sprint division. Let's hope to see 
a performance worthy of it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you what I've got! Watch closely 
and get excited!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: ...Was that... directed at me just now...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, give the signal to enter the track! 
Hurry!
